name: gemini-advisor
description: Multi-tier capability routing with JEV micro-routing: Frontier models (Gemini 4 Argon / Claude Opus) advise at Three Golden Triggers, Execution models (Flash 3.8 / Sonnet 5.5) build code, and Lite scouts (Flash-Lite / Haiku) explore in parallel.

interface.shortDescription: 4-Tier multi-agent hierarchy with JEV micro-routing, on-call Advisor, and parallel scouts.
interface.longDescription: Gemini Advisor is a capability-routed software delivery plugin for Antigravity and Claude Code. It organizes engineering into a 4-tier cognitive tree: On-Call Frontier Advisor (Gemini 4 Argon / Claude Opus) stepping in strictly at Three Golden Triggers (Plan Lock, Error Loop 2x, Task Done), fast Execution Builders (Gemini Flash / Sonnet), parallel read-only Scouts (search, grep, docs on Flash-Lite / Haiku), and sub-millisecond JEV micro-routing (<0.02ms) for fast deterministic forks.
